snippet.title: Appulse - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover pinball like never before with Appulse!

The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.


Whishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498700/Appulse
